climate: Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A South Australian region in the Mount Lofty Ranges, within the Barossa zone, from Truro in the north to just south of Springton, with a GI since 1997. High Eden lies inside it. Shiraz is 36 percent of plantings and Riesling 23 percent.
